pooled_design: each campaign generates a 90-member correlated pool; config (m) uses the first m members (exchangeable), config (B) uses nested prefixes of one 2000-replicate draw - valid per-config, cross-config estimates correlated
campaign_seeding: per-campaign default_rng([stage_seed, c]) - deterministic and resume-safe; campaigns are mutually independent
sharding: merged from 8 strided shards; union of campaigns is bit-identical to a sequential run (same per-campaign seeds)
